# Adarsh P Kumar

> Freelance project manager based in Bengaluru, India, running end-to-end website design and development, UI/UX, SaaS, enterprise applications, technical SEO, branding, and AI and automation projects. 140+ projects shipped, 13 years of delivery experience, 98% client retention. Works with clients in India, the US, the UK, the UAE, and Australia.

## Services

- Website design and development: marketing sites, e-commerce, and headless CMS builds with Core Web Vitals and technical SEO as acceptance criteria.
- UI/UX design: research, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and design systems delivered as developer-ready files.
- Enterprise applications: internal tools, portals, system integrations, and legacy migrations run with change control.
- SaaS delivery: MVP to v2 delivery, roadmap, release trains, and multi-tenant rollout.
- Growth marketing (SEO): technical SEO, content programs, paid campaigns, and analytics under one plan.
- Branding: identity, naming, messaging, and brand guidelines, rolled out across every existing touchpoint.
- AI and automation: AI features, internal copilots, and workflow automation from pilot to production, with human review built in.
- Project rescue: taking over late or stalled projects, starting with a short paid audit and a re-baselined scope.

## Key facts

- 140+ projects shipped, 60+ web and UI/UX builds, 25+ SaaS and enterprise platforms, 18+ AI and automation rollouts.
- 13 years of delivery experience, 98% client retention.
- Fixed-fee or retainer pricing, with a written scope and quote before work begins.
- Based in Bengaluru, India. Works async-first with clients across India, the US, the UK, the UAE, and Australia.
- Replies within 1 working day.
